d: Spiky, golden-blonde hair is styled in a high ponytail with long, unruly strands and uneven bangs framing a youthful, teenage face. Golden-amber eyes are wide and expressive, set above a cheerful smile. A slender build is dressed in a short, cropped white shirt under an open, bright orange technical jacket featuring grey fur lining on the collar, multiple utility pockets, and a "SOL" identification patch. Accessories include a black choker, a silver pendant necklace, and a complex grey utility belt laden with metal rings, clips, and straps.
